description:
Redwood Inference is seeing increasing enterprise deal volume where security/compliance review and formal RFPs are gating procurement for Dedicated and Private deployments. The goal of this project is to refresh the Enterprise Security Enablement Kit used by Sales, Solutions Engineering, Security/GRC, and Customer Success: (1) an up-to-date security FAQ aligned to current product capabilities (Hosted/Dedicated/Private), (2) refreshed compliance one-pagers (SOC 2 posture, ISO alignment, data residency/retention, encryption/KMS, audit logging, SSO/RBAC), and (3) a standardized RFP response library with approved language and an internal process for maintaining claims.

Scope includes: auditing existing customer-facing claims, incorporating recurring questions from sales calls and support tickets, drafting updated artifacts in Google Drive, running cross-functional reviews (Security/GRC, Product Security PM, Solutions Engineering, Legal/Finance where contractual language appears), publishing final versions to Confluence sales enablement and security/compliance spaces, and updating any public-facing documentation (redwood-docs) that the kit links to. Non-goals: introducing new product features; the kit must not promise roadmap items.

Key stakeholders: Dr. Aisha Rahman (CISO) and Security Engineering (Marcus Lin, Kevin Osei) for technical accuracy; GRC (Olga Petrov, Daniel Carter) for audit/compliance language; Product Security PM (Naomi Feldman) for capability/roadmap alignment; Solutions Engineering (Markus Klein, Fatima Noor, Colin O'Donnell) for deployment-specific details; Product Marketing (Soojin Lee, Camila Reyes) for messaging consistency; Sales leadership and AEs (Jordan Blake, Stephanie Nguyen, Lukas Meyer, Avery Johnson, Priyom Das, Hannah Schmitt) for field readiness; CS leadership (Jasmine Liu, Rachel Kim) for operational handoffs.

Proposed timeline (6–8 weeks): Week 1–2 intake + gap analysis; Week 3–4 drafting and claims-matrix build; Week 5 review cycle + redlines; Week 6 publish + link updates; Week 7–8 sales training and CRM rollout. Constraints: confidentiality controls for restricted evidence, region-specific data residency claims, versioning/change log discipline, and a single source of truth for approved RFP language.

files.description: Published security FAQ (Hosted/Dedicated/Private): encryption, data handling, retention/deletion, SSO/SAML, RBAC, audit logs, vuln mgmt, incident response, subprocessors, and common questionnaire answers; includes "last reviewed" and links to evidence process.
Change log and versioning policy for the security FAQ: what changed, why, approvers, and how Sales should reference versions in RFPs.
Approved claims/anti-claims guidance (e.g., ISO language, data residency nuance, pen test wording, "no training on customer data" definitions) to prevent over-commitment in RFP responses.
Copy/paste standard answers for high-frequency controls (SSO/SAML, SCIM, RBAC granularity, audit log fields/exports, retention controls) with product references.
Messaging framework for enterprise security: key pillars, proof points per deployment mode, and "competitive-safe" wording aligned to product marketing.
Single Confluence index page that links to the current FAQ, one-pagers, RFP library, evidence request process, and internal owners/SLAs.
Internal guidance on what is included in base plans vs enterprise/compliance add-ons (audit log retention, evidence support SLAs, private deployment options) and how to describe it.
Customer-facing explanation of data retention, deletion, log retention, and configurable controls across Hosted/Dedicated/Private; includes regional residency considerations.
Audit logging overview: event taxonomy, export options (SIEM/S3), retention controls, and limitations; includes diagrams described in text.
Authoritative internal reference for SSO/SAML/SCIM and RBAC: supported IdPs, role model, API/console coverage, and roadmap disclaimers for Sales/SE use.
Process for handling SOC 2/evidence requests: intake form, NDA requirements, artifact list, response timelines, and where evidence is stored.
Policy for exceptions when a questionnaire asks for non-supported controls; defines escalation path, approvers, and approved alternative language.
RFP response operating procedure: who can approve security/legal language, required reviews, and how to track deviations from standard language.
CS/Support handoff for late-stage security reviews: how Sales/SE loops in Security, how to handle urgent deadlines, and escalation tiers.
Product definition doc for an "Enterprise Compliance Pack" concept (what capabilities/docs/support are bundled) to keep GTM and Product aligned.
Working outline for the refreshed FAQ: sections, open questions, source links (Slack/Fireflies), and owner assignments per section.
Raw intake doc compiled from AEs/SEs: top customer questions, which accounts asked them, and suggested answers needing Security review.
Draft RFP response bank (copy blocks) organized by domain: security program, data protection, access controls, audit logging, SDLC, IR/BCP, subprocessors.
Draft SOC 2 one-pager: scope, control themes, audit period, how to request report under NDA, and how controls map to product features.
Draft ISO/27001-alignment one-pager: wording guidance to avoid misrepresentation, mapping of key Annex A themes to Redwood controls.
Draft data residency + retention one-pager: region availability, data flows, log retention, and Private/VPC options.
Draft encryption one-pager: in-transit/at-rest, KMS/HSM options by deployment mode, key ownership boundaries, and audit log tie-ins.
Sheet tracking each artifact, canonical link, version/date, owner, last review, and which HubSpot snippets/templates reference it.
Internal training notes for Sales/SE: how to use the kit, what changed, common pitfalls, and escalation contacts.
Sheet: claims matrix mapping questionnaire prompts to approved language, evidence availability, and owner; includes red/yellow/green confidence ratings.
Sheet used by GRC to track incoming evidence requests: account, due date, NDA status, requested artifacts, status, and assigned analyst.
PM umbrella ticket: scope, milestones, deliverables, approvers, and launch checklist for the enablement kit update.
PM ticket defining RFP library structure, approval workflow, and ownership model across GTM/Security/Legal.
PM ticket to align product behavior and customer-facing wording around retention/deletion and audit log retention options.
Engineering ticket for updating redwood-docs with a public-friendly security overview page and links to gated evidence request process.
Engineering ticket to add documentation/examples for audit log export integrations referenced by the enablement kit.
Design ticket: update one-pager layout (branding, sections, icons) for SOC2/ISO/data residency/encryption one-pagers.
Design ticket to create a simple data-flow diagram used across one-pagers and FAQ (hosted, dedicated, private).
PR adding/refreshing a public enterprise security overview in docs: structure, approved wording, and link stubs to request SOC 2 report.
PR updating docs pages for audit logging: event types, export destinations, and configuration examples used by SEs.
PR tightening language around retention/residency, including deployment-mode-specific caveats and a glossary for Sales/SE alignment.
PR adding internal admin/snippet support (or config) to centrally manage approved FAQ/RFP text blocks used by GTM tooling.
PR adding a generated RBAC capabilities summary (roles/permissions) that is referenced by the RFP library and SE responses.
